scope: research implementation and synthetic tests only; no actual data or performance evaluation
cutoff: for each target date include only train dates <= target date minus seven days; duplicate training IDs rejected; target labels are not inputs
spaces: market=market probabilities; combined=market+DC; form=market+DC+12 form features; for form, standardize all concatenated columns with the eligible training bank mean and population standard deviation, with zero deviations set to one; neither targets nor excluded future rows influence fit
distance: Euclidean, sort by distance then unique training ID, use first k; if fewer than k eligible rows, return the original market distribution
prediction: normalize uniform or inverse distance 1/(distance+0.05) weights to sum k, then multiply exp2(-days/half_life), or 1 if null; sum weighted (onehot-label minus train-market); add blend times this sum divided by sum of weights plus prior to target-market, clip at 1e-6 and normalize
limitations: Date cutoff is a conservative lag convention, not proof of actual result receipt or independent future evidence. Historical data may have been previously inspected. No production or model promotion.
